# t9.1 — Remediation: RunReviewPort List Return + OUT-02/OUT-03 Reachability

## Summary

Fixed the structural defect introduced in t9 where `RunReviewPort.execute()` collapsed all
per-agent `ReviewResult` objects into a single aggregated blob before returning. This made
OUT-02 (`{agent-name}-report.md`) and OUT-03 (`{agent-name}-pass-{n}-report.md`) structurally
unreachable regardless of downstream logic.

Five files changed; full Maven build passes: **907 tests, 0 failures**.

---

## Root Cause

`ReviewOrchestrator.runReview()` correctly produced a `List<ReviewResult>` (one per agent per
pass) internally, but then called `aggregateResults()` which joined all content with `---`
dividers and returned a single synthesised result. The `RunReviewPort` interface mandated a
single `ReviewResult` return. Callers then wrapped the one result in `List.of(...)` before
handing it to `GenerateReportPort.generate()`, so only one file was ever possible.

---

## Changes Made

### 1. `domain/report/ReviewResult.java`
- Added `int passNumber` as the 7th record field.
  - `0` → single-pass / no pass label (maps to OUT-02 filename: `{agent}-report.md`)
  - `≥1` → numbered pass in a multi-pass run (maps to OUT-03 filename: `{agent}-pass-{n}-report.md`)
- Added `withPassNumber(int newPassNumber)` wither for immutable copy-with-update.
- Added `private int passNumber = 0` to `Builder` with fluent setter.
- Updated `Builder.build()` to pass all 7 args to the record canonical constructor.
- No existing call sites broken: all call through `Builder` which defaults `passNumber=0`.

### 2. `application/port/inbound/RunReviewPort.java`
- Changed return type: `ReviewResult execute(ReviewRequest)` → `List<ReviewResult> execute(ReviewRequest)`
- Added `import java.util.List`.
- Javadoc updated: explains that the list preserves per-agent identity required for OUT-02/OUT-03.

### 3. `application/review/ReviewOrchestrator.java`
- Changed `execute()` return type to `List<ReviewResult>`.
- `runReview()` now returns `List<ReviewResult>` directly (the raw `allResults` list from
  `ReviewExecutionModeRunner`).
- **Removed `aggregateResults()` private method** — the aggregation logic no longer exists in
  the new application layer.
- Removed `import java.util.stream.Collectors` (was only used by the removed method).

### 4. `application/review/ReviewPassRunner.java`
- In the pass loop, each raw result is now conditionally tagged:
  ```java
  ReviewResult tagged = passes > 1 ? raw.withPassNumber(currentPass) : raw;
  results.add(tagged);
  ```
  - Single-pass runs: `passNumber` stays `0` → filename `{agent}-report.md` (OUT-02)
  - Multi-pass runs: `passNumber` set to `1`, `2`, … → filename `{agent}-pass-{n}-report.md` (OUT-03)

### 5. `application/report/GenerateReportUseCase.java`
- Replaced the broken filename logic `"%s_%s.md".formatted(safeName, date)` with:
  ```java
  String filename = result.passNumber() > 0
      ? "%s-pass-%d-report.md".formatted(safeName, result.passNumber())
      : "%s-report.md".formatted(safeName);
  ```
- Fixed null-safety: `result.agentConfig() != null ? result.agentConfig().name() : "unknown"`
  guards the agent name extraction, preventing NPE when `agentConfig` is absent on error results.

---

## Behavior Coverage Restored

| Behavior | Filename Pattern             | Condition             | Status |
|----------|------------------------------|-----------------------|--------|
| OUT-02   | `{agent-name}-report.md`     | `passNumber == 0`     | ✅ Reachable |
| OUT-03   | `{agent-name}-pass-{n}-report.md` | `passNumber >= 1` | ✅ Reachable |
